description:
pkix-ct/src/delivery.rs:88-105 — the function walks tbs_response_data.responses[*].single_extensions linearly and returns the first SCT-list it finds. RFC 6960 §4.2.1 allows multiple SingleResponses in one BasicOcspResponse, each potentially carrying a different SCT-list for a different cert.

Two unusual but legitimate deployments break:
1. OCSP responder bundles status+SCTs for multiple certs in one response (rare but legal).
2. SCT-list extension appears in BOTH a SingleResponse and the top-level response_extensions — the SingleResponse one wins by traversal order.

Caller has no way to tell which cert the returned SCT-list applies to. Caller of verify_sct_for_cert / verify_sct_for_precert then validates SCTs against an arbitrary cert they pass in; if it doesn't match the SingleResponse's CertID, signature verification fails by accident.

Practical impact: low (deployed OCSP responders rarely return multi-cert responses). Design impact: the function's signature carries no way to disambiguate. Once callers depend on it, fixing the API is breaking.

Suggested fix (pre-launch): take a CertID matcher as input, or return a struct that records which SingleResponse the SCTs came from. Document this constraint explicitly even if behavior stays as-is.
title: sct_list_from_ocsp_response returns first SCT-list found across multiple SingleResponses without telling caller which
